tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows saturation and the source notes identify a two-layer siphon, but the fixed horizon and other fixed inputs cannot identify its dynamics. The open-branch probe can discriminate the plausible mechanisms before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary saturation curve to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations vary only u_now, leaving the two-layer bridge dynamics and other input dependencies unidentified.
The open-branch probe is cheaper and directly addresses the current mechanism ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
